divergences.upstreamResult: Base UI integrates with React synthetic handlers while preserving native input behavior.
divergences.octaneResult: The Octane binding integrates directly with native input events.
divergences.rationale: Octane intentionally uses the browser event model rather than React's synthetic event layer.
divergences.consumerImpact: Handler timing and event object details can differ when consumers inspect React-specific fields.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use native input semantics and avoid depending on React SyntheticEvent-only fields.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adds a React-compatible synthetic event layer.

divergences.upstreamResult: React composes render-element refs and class names through React element cloning semantics.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane reproduces the rendered result through its native ref-as-prop and class composition model.
divergences.rationale: The frameworks expose different internal element and ref composition primitives.
divergences.consumerImpact: React-only element identity or ref implementation details are not portable even when DOM output matches.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Depend on the resulting DOM, composed class names, and public refs rather than React element identity.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane changes render-element or ref composition semantics.

divergences.upstreamResult: The active tooltip consumers record 11 and 7 passive commits; the unrelated consumer remains at its three initial commits.
divergences.octaneResult: Active consumers can commit a different number of times while finite layout cascades settle. The unrelated consumer retains exactly its three initial commits.
divergences.rationale: Octane completes layout-driven updates before DOM observer delivery and does not promise React's incidental commit counts. The test retains its no-unrelated-update assertion and verifies active consumers update.
divergences.consumerImpact: Effects in actively updating components may execute a different number of times. Unrelated delay-group consumers remain unaffected.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use effect dependencies and cleanup; depend on visible state and unrelated-consumer isolation instead of absolute active commit counts.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane changes layout cascade scheduling or commits updates to unrelated delay-group consumers.
